items.title: George Benson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Kenny Barron? [INTERVIEWEE] No, white. Oh, actually, he’s from the – either part Mexican – what’s his name? Chick Corea.

ctx.x: He told me one day he was coming out of the bathroom – he was coming out of his office, which was catty-corner from the bathroom, and a guy came out of the bathroom, stuck a pistol in his nose, backed him up into the office, tied him up to a chair, and put a gag on him. Then he asked him for the number to the safe. “What’s the number to the safe?” He was trying to tell him, but the cat had a band-aid on his mouth. He was “Ummmmmm” and the cat was beating him with the gun. “What’s the number to the safe?”…
No, white. Oh, actually, he’s from the – either part Mexican – what’s his name? Chick Corea.
